title: Complementary use of lead isotopes, tin isotopes, and trace elements to infer the sources of tin in bronzes from southern Africa, ca. 1200–1800 CE
core_idea: Integrate lead and tin isotope analyses with trace element measurements to identify geographic sources of tin in 153 tin and bronze samples from southern Africa dated 1200–1800 CE.
tldr: Use combined isotopic and trace element chemistry to trace the provenance of tin used in southern African bronzes between 1200 and 1800 CE.
